test_framework: go test with testify (is := assert.New(t)), mocks in internal/service/downloader_test.go
verification_instructions: make swag; go vet ./...; go test -race -shuffle=on ./...
snapshot_or_generated_files: docs/docs.go, docs/swagger.json, docs/swagger.yaml via `make swag` (swag init -g cmd/server/main.go)
environment_constraints: swag binary at $(go env GOPATH)/bin/swag; install with go install github.com/swaggo/swag/cmd/swag@latest if missing
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md: load golang-how-to skill; update Swagger annotations/model tags, run make swag, update API.md and README.md in English, run go test -race -shuffle=on ./... and go vet ./... No generic type args in swaggo annotations.
key_patterns: Request structs in internal/model/request.go; handlers in internal/handler/{platform,unified}_handler.go; service in internal/service/downloader.go; runners in internal/ytdlp, internal/gallerydl, internal/threads. Global proxy via cfg.ProxyURL (PROXY_URL env).
